fluff.overview:
The Taurian Defense Force assigns conventional infantry to garrison and planetary defense roles across the Concordat, where citizen-soldiers serve out of patriotic duty rather than mere obligation. Motorized platoons provide faster response than foot infantry without the cost of full mechanized transport, riding light vehicles or motorcycles that can cover ground quickly on the road networks connecting Taurian population centers. Their speed makes them well-suited to the wide-area patrol duties that Concordat garrison doctrine demands.

Support squads operate portable or crew-served machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire, providing suppression capability that can pin down enemy infantry and threaten light vehicles.
